comment.body:
Thanks for calling out that the hit target is limited to the upper-right quarter of the close button. Right now the report does not show whether this is a DPI/title-bar layout mismatch, a non-client hit-test problem, or a theme/display-specific issue on Windows 10.

**Needed**
1. Please upload a short screen recording that shows the cursor clicking across the full width and height of the close button so we can see exactly which region responds.
2. Please confirm the monitor resolution, display scaling, and whether the window is on the primary or a secondary monitor when this happens.
3. Could you also confirm whether the same behavior still reproduces on the latest PowerToys stable build?

This will separate a current title-bar hit-test bug from an older-build or display-scaling issue.
